FACTS_ALLOWED_IN_BODY: NHTSA distinguishes the detailed vehicle-specific emergency response guide from the abbreviated rescue sheet for responders and provides make/model filtering for different electric powertrains.
Tesla provides separate Model 3 emergency response guides and rescue sheets for 2017–2023 and 2024 onward, demonstrating the need to match production period as well as model.
Mercedes-Benz offers rescue-sheet lookup through VIN/FIN, model filtering or its rescue-sticker QR code. Sheets describe vehicle construction and safety-system locations for rescue personnel.

Kia explicitly limits these sheets to vehicles intended for Europe, warns that right-hand-drive variants may differ, and states the information is for trained emergency personnel rather than customers, dealers or workshops.
Mercedes-Benz Japan explains that rescue guidance differs by propulsion type, and links users to rescue guidance and model/VIN-based rescue cards.

Tesla separates vehicle-owner accident information from responder resources and directs first and second responders to appropriate support channels; document access does not replace specialist training.
